cain.chase.escaped.text: Abel got home to his father and mother. You are a good person: you did not want to kill Abel, and that is good. But it did not happen that way. Play it again as the Bible tells it.

cain.command.0.text: Cain, Abel. Bring me an offering, each of you, from the work of your hands.

cain.command.1.text: I will bring the fruit of my field.

cain.command.2.text: And I, the firstlings of my flock.

cain.fear.0.text: Cain? What are you doing with that?

cain.field.0.text: Abel. Come with me, let us go out to the field.

cain.herd.0.text: Come, boy! Bring them in to the fold.

cain.npc.adam.after.0.text: The LORD looked on your brother's offering. Do not let your heart grow dark.

cain.npc.adam.after.1.text: Anger is a heavy thing to carry, son. Put it down.

cain.npc.adam.after.2.text: Where is your brother? He should be home before the evening.

cain.npc.adam.before.0.text: I worked the ground by the sweat of my brow. Now my sons work it with me.

cain.npc.adam.before.1.text: Bring the LORD your best, my son.

cain.npc.adam.before.2.text: We could not go back to the garden. But the LORD has not left us.

cain.npc.adam.before.3.text: Cain keeps the field, Abel keeps the sheep. Each has his work.

cain.npc.eve.after.0.text: Your face has fallen, Cain. What is it?

cain.npc.eve.after.1.text: Make peace with your brother before the sun goes down.

cain.npc.eve.after.2.text: Is Abel with you? I have kept his bread warm.

cain.npc.eve.before.0.text: I have gotten a man from the LORD. And then another. My two sons.

cain.npc.eve.before.1.text: The pot is almost ready. Go on, do your work first.

cain.npc.eve.before.2.text: Take care of your brother, Cain.

cain.npc.eve.before.3.text: The tunics the LORD made us still keep us warm.

cain.rebuke.0.text: Why are you angry? Why has your face fallen?

cain.rebuke.1.text: If you do well, will you not be accepted? If not, sin lies at the door. It wants you, but you must rule over it.

cain.scripture.born.text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

cain.scripture.firstlings.text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof.

cain.scripture.keeper.text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

cain.scripture.mark.text: And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

cain.scripture.nod.text: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

cain.scripture.respect.text: And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering: but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect.

cain.scripture.slew.text: And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

cain.scripture.wroth.text: And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

cain.where.1.text: I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?

cain.where.2.text: What have you done? Your brother's blood cries to me from the ground. You will be a wanderer on the earth.

creation.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

m02_command.0.text: Eat freely from every tree — but not from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. The day you eat of it, you will surely die.

m02_forbidden.0.text: The tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

m03_intro.0.text: It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.

m04_wake.0.text: This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. She shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

m05_intro.0.text: Let us gather fruit — from every tree but one.

m05_share.0.text: Every tree is a gift — all but the one in the midst.

m06_serpent.0.text: Did God really say, “You shall not eat of any tree of the garden”?

m06_serpent.1.text: We may eat from the trees, but not from the one in the midst, or we will die.

m06_serpent.2.text: You will not surely die. God knows your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.

m08_answer.0.text: I heard your voice and was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid.

m08_answer.1.text: Did you eat from the tree I commanded you not to eat from?

m08_answer.2.text: The woman you gave me — she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate.

m08_answer.3.text: What is this that you have done?

m08_answer.4.text: The serpent deceived me, and I ate.

m09_adam.0.text: The ground is cursed because of you; it will bring thorns and thistles. Dust you are, and to dust you will return.

m09_serpent.0.text: You are cursed; on your belly you will go. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.

m09_woman.0.text: In pain you will bear children. You will long for your husband, and he will rule over you.

m10_intro.0.text: The man now knows good and evil. He must not take from the tree of life and live forever.

noah.animals-in.0.text: Seven pairs of the clean beasts went in, and one pair of the unclean.

noah.awoke.0.text: I know what you did, Ham. Cursed be Canaan, your son: a servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.

noah.awoke.1.text: Blessed be the LORD God of Shem. God shall enlarge Japheth.

noah.blessed.0.text: Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth.

noah.call-back.0.text: Come back, little dove! There is no land yet.

noah.call-ham.0.text: Already? The sky is clear… Fine, fine.

noah.call-shem.0.text: I'm coming, father. The LORD has spoken.

noah.come-in.0.text: Come into the ark, you and all your house: I have seen you righteous before me.

noah.come-in.1.text: Take seven pairs of every clean beast and fowl, and one pair of the unclean.

noah.come-in.2.text: And take food for you and for them. In seven days I will send rain.

noah.covenant.0.text: I make my covenant with you: never again will a flood destroy the earth.

noah.gather-food.0.text: Now the food, for us and for every beast. Help me carry it.

noah.generations.0.text: Many generations after Adam, people filled the earth, and their hearts turned to evil.

noah.go-forth.0.text: Go out of the ark, you, your wife, your sons and their wives.

noah.go-forth.1.text: Bring out every living thing with you, that they may fill the earth.

noah.ham-saw.0.text: Father is drunk… and uncovered! Wait until my brothers hear this.

noah.ham-tells.0.text: Come and see our father! He lies drunk and naked in his tent!

noah.ham-tells.1.text: We will not look at our father's shame.

noah.ham-tells.2.text: Take the garment. We'll walk in backward.

noah.lion.0.text: One pair of the unclean, the LORD said. Come, lion. Gently.

noah.make-ark.0.text: Noah, the earth is filled with violence. Make an ark of gopher wood.

noah.make-ark.1.text: I will bring a flood on the earth. But with you I will establish my covenant.

noah.mock.0.text: A boat? On a hill? Ha!

noah.mock.2.text: Turn from your ways. The LORD sees everything.

noah.npc.baker.before.0.text: Up before the sun to bake, and they take it like it's theirs.

noah.npc.baker.before.1.text: No one in this city lifts a finger for another.

noah.npc.baker.days.0.text: Bread for a boat? Ha. Who would buy bread on a boat?

noah.npc.debtor.before.0.text: I owe the giant. Everyone owes the giant.

noah.npc.debtor.days.0.text: They say the old man's God is kind. Is that true?

noah.npc.farmer.before.0.text: Sand! He sold me sand for my good goat.

noah.npc.farmer.before.1.text: You can't trust a soul in this city.

noah.npc.farmer.days.0.text: Fine weather for the fields. Rain? What nonsense.

noah.npc.giant.before.0.text: I am a mighty man of renown. Bow down, little one.

noah.npc.ham-wife.after.0.text: We were eight in the ark. Only eight.

noah.npc.ham-wife.before.0.text: The city frightens me. Men there do whatever they want.

noah.npc.ham-wife.days.0.text: Where is Ham? Have you seen him?

noah.npc.ham.after.0.text: One hundred and fifty days of water. I never want to see a fish again.

noah.npc.ham.before.0.text: A boat on dry land. The neighbours think we're mad.

noah.npc.ham.before.1.text: I'll help… after I rest a little.

noah.npc.ham.days.0.text: Is it really going to rain? Not one cloud.

noah.npc.japheth-wife.after.0.text: Look, the olive trees are growing again!

noah.npc.japheth-wife.before.0.text: The neighbours stole our goat last week. Nobody did anything.

noah.npc.japheth-wife.days.0.text: Hay for the animals is out in the meadows.

noah.npc.japheth.after.0.text: The whole world is new. Where shall we go first?

noah.npc.japheth.before.0.text: I want to see the animals come! Even the lion!

noah.npc.japheth.before.1.text: Two by two, father says. How will they all fit?

noah.npc.japheth.days.0.text: The deer are in the meadows to the south-east.

noah.npc.mocker.before.0.text: Where's the sea, old man? Ha!

noah.npc.mocker.before.1.text: A boat on dry land. Now I've seen everything.

noah.npc.mocker.days.0.text: Still at it, Noah? You'll be building till you die!

noah.npc.noah-wife.after.0.text: Dry ground! I thought I'd never walk on grass again.

noah.npc.noah-wife.after.1.text: So quiet after all that rain.

noah.npc.noah-wife.before.0.text: Noah walks with God. People laugh at him, but I don't.

noah.npc.noah-wife.before.1.text: An ark? Here? If the LORD says so, then build it, husband.

noah.npc.noah-wife.before.2.text: Be careful in the city. It's not safe anymore.

noah.npc.noah-wife.days.0.text: Seven days… Hurry, Noah, call the boys!

noah.npc.noah-wife.days.1.text: Don't forget the food. The animals will be hungry.

noah.npc.noah.after.0.text: The LORD kept us through the water. Never forget it, son.

noah.npc.noah.after.1.text: Every time it rains, look for the bow in the cloud.

noah.npc.shem-wife.after.0.text: The sky is so clean. Like the first morning.

noah.npc.shem-wife.before.0.text: My father-in-law prays every morning. The others only shout.

noah.npc.shem-wife.days.0.text: I'll carry what I can. We need grain for many days.

noah.npc.shem.after.0.text: Blessed be the LORD, who kept us alive.

noah.npc.shem.before.0.text: Father says the LORD spoke to him. I believe him.

noah.npc.shem.before.1.text: Gopher wood is strong. Fell it near the forest paths.

noah.npc.shem.days.0.text: Seven pairs of the clean animals, father. I'll count them with you.

noah.npc.thief.before.0.text: What are you looking at? I found it.

noah.npc.thief.before.1.text: A loaf here, a purse there. Who's counting?

noah.npc.thief.days.0.text: Everyone's busy laughing at Noah. Good for business.

noah.npc.wicked-b.before.1.text: Build your boat. We'll laugh from the hill.

noah.npc.wicked-c.before.0.text: Everyone lies. I'm just better at it.

noah.npc.wicked-c.days.0.text: Go on, get in your box. We'll be at the feast.

noah.npc.wicked-woman.before.1.text: Don't trust anyone in this city.

noah.npc.wicked-woman.days.0.text: They say old Noah built a giant boat. Strange man.

noah.npc.wicked.before.1.text: In this city the strong take what they want.

noah.npc.wicked.days.0.text: Eat, drink, marry. Tomorrow is like today.

noah.raven-lost.0.text: The raven went to and fro, and did not come back to the ark.

noah.remember.0.text: When the bow is in the cloud, I will look on it and remember my covenant.

noah.repent.0.text: I will wipe man whom I have created from the face of the earth.

noah.scripture.afloat.text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days: and God remembered Noah, and the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.

noah.scripture.again.text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark.

noah.scripture.altar.text: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

noah.scripture.bow.text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

noah.scripture.built.text: So Noah and his sons built the ark of gopher wood, with rooms in it, and pitched it within and without with pitch.

noah.scripture.corrupt.text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

noah.scripture.covered.text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered their father; and their faces were backward.

noah.scripture.did.text: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

noah.scripture.dove.text: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground.

noah.scripture.drunk.text: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

noah.scripture.dry.text: And Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

noah.scripture.enter.text: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

noah.scripture.fountains.text: The same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened. And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

noah.scripture.giants.text: There were giants in the earth in those days.

noah.scripture.grace.text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

noah.scripture.grieved.text: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

noah.scripture.husbandman.text: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard.

noah.scripture.just.text: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

noah.scripture.no-rest.text: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark.

noah.scripture.not-again.text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

noah.scripture.olive.text: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

noah.scripture.savour.text: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour.

noah.scripture.scattered.text: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

noah.scripture.seedtime.text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

noah.scripture.shut.text: And the LORD shut him in.

noah.scripture.sons.text: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

noah.scripture.wicked.text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

noah.scripture.window.text: Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made: and he sent forth a raven.

noah.scripture.years.text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years. And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

noah.sin-harass.1.text: Where are you going? Stay with me.

noah.sin-lies.0.text: Two sacks of wheat for your goat. A fair trade, I swear it.

noah.sin-violence.1.text: No one says no to me.

noah.tell-ham.0.text: Ham, no flood will ever destroy the earth again.

noah.tell-ham.1.text: Good. I've had enough water for a lifetime.

noah.tell-japheth.0.text: Japheth, the bow is God's sign. Be fruitful and fill the earth.

noah.tell-japheth.1.text: So many colours! I'll tell my children about it.

noah.tell-shem.0.text: Shem, see the bow? It is the LORD's promise.

noah.tell-shem.1.text: Blessed be the LORD. I will remember it.

noah.to-ark.0.text: That's all of it. Come, into the ark!

noah.too-late.0.text: Seven days passed, and not all were in the ark. Try again.

scripture.gen2_15.text: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

scripture.gen2_20.text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

scripture.gen2_22.text: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

scripture.gen3_21.text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

scripture.gen3_24.text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

scripture.gen3_6.text: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
